title: Crosswalk dataset recipe (schema_version 1)
description: One file per city dataset: everything a contributor declares (identity, where to fetch, how to conform, license evidence) and everything a reviewer decides (publication gates). Machine-generated run state (fetch provenance, quality fingerprints) does NOT belong in this file. See docs/plans/2026-07-06-dataset-registry-format.md.

schema_version.description: Recipe schema version. Bump only on breaking changes; loaders must reject versions they do not know.

name.description: Dataset identifier and registry key. Must equal the filename stem and is used verbatim in labels/, bridges/dataset=<name>/, and mbench.

type.description: Network kind; drives matching defaults (e.g. cross-tier blocking).

source.description: Where the data comes from. Mirrors crosswalk.datasets.schema.SourceConfig.

portal_url.description: Human-readable portal / documentation page for the dataset.

fetch.description: How to conform the source to crosswalk's model (the OpenAddresses 'conform' analog). Mirrors crosswalk.datasets.schema.FetchConfig.

classification.description: Class-mapping rules discovered via `crosswalk discover-classes`. Kept loose: written by tooling, reviewed by humans.

license.description: License facts + publication gates. `status`/`geometry_status` are HUMAN DECISIONS (default-deny; the publisher never guesses); everything else is evidence supporting them.

status.description: Gate for the ID-only bridge table. Only a human flips this to approved.

geometry_status.description: Gate for geometry-bearing artifacts (unmatched-segment export, #321). Missing = pending_review. Approving geometry requires redistribution rights to the data itself.

spdx.description: SPDX identifier when one exists (e.g. PDDL-1.0, CC-BY-4.0, ODbL-1.0). null/omitted for custom terms — put the full name in `name`.

name.description: Full license name as the source states it (e.g. "Open Government Licence – Toronto", "SITG open geodata terms"). Required when `spdx` is absent. Replaces licenses.toml `likely_license`.

attribution.description: The attribution text shipped with published artifacts. Required when status = approved.

proposed_attribution.description: Draft attribution written during research, promoted to `attribution` on approval.

capabilities.description: What the terms permit, DMFR-style tri-state flags (yes/no/unknown). Evidence for the gates, not the gates themselves — `status`/`geometry_status` remain explicit human decisions.

review.description: Provenance of the license research: who/what recommended, on what evidence. Written by the AI research panel and by human reviewers; never consumed by the publish gate.

evidence.description: URLs actually fetched, with the quotes that carry the conclusion.
